summary: package.json#files publishes source maps but not the src/ and types/ sources they reference.
test_command: npm ci --prefer-offline --no-audit --no-fund --loglevel=error && { ( rm -rf dist && npx tsc && node --test --test-skip-pattern=CLI ) 2>&1 | tee node_modules/.bench-out.txt; rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}; if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then if grep -qE "TSError|error TS[0-9]+|Cannot find module|ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND|SyntaxError:" node_modules/.bench-out.txt; then echo "[setup failed] a test file failed to load"; elif grep -qE "AssertionError|[0-9]+ failing|^# fail [1-9]|ℹ fail [1-9]" node_modules/.bench-out.txt; then echo "--- FAIL: assertion failures"; fi; elif { [ -e test/bench_package_files.test.js ]; } && ! grep -q "bench:" node_modules/.bench-out.txt; then echo "[setup failed] hidden tests did not run"; rc=1; fi; exit $rc; }
test_command_note: The repository's `CLI` tests spawn bin/cli.js through a POSIX shell, are unrelated to this task and are skipped on every host with --test-skip-pattern (Node >= 22). The repository's exports_test.sh (npm install of a packed tarball under /tmp) is not run; the hidden test inspects `npm pack --dry-run --json` instead, which needs no network.

provenance.note: Evaluator-only. base_sha is the parent of the first upstream fix for issue #310; the fix was completed in a follow-up commit, and the reference patch is the package.json diff from base_sha to that follow-up (it also carries the 4.0.2 version bump that landed in between). Neither commit is reachable from the sealed clone.
provenance.dependency_cache: test_command runs `npm ci` against the committed package-lock.json on every invocation. The time budget (< 2 minutes per run) assumes a warm npm cache (~/.npm/_cacache) holding this lockfile's packages, e.g. pre-seeded by one verifier run or a cache image; the first cold run downloads from the npm registry. Agents need no network for tests once the cache is warm.
provenance.test_runner: node:test (built in) after `tsc`, the repository's own `node --test` invocation; hidden tests are plain ESM JavaScript under test/. Failure classification greps the captured output. Hidden-test guard: when the hidden test files are present, a run that exits 0 must show that they ran (jest/vitest: the JSON report has a bench_/bench- test file with at least one passed and no failed assertion; mocha/node:test: the captured output contains a `bench:` suite title); otherwise the command prints `[setup failed] hidden tests did not run` and exits 1.

reference.note: Evaluator-only. The verifier renders the reference patch from upstream: git diff --binary -M base_sha commit -- paths, per step.
